description:
The PostJoy F30 Moped Style Ebike is built for riders who want bold moped-inspired style, powerful electric performance, and all-terrain comfort in one capable fat tire e-bike. With a 2500W peak motor, 32 MPH top speed, 48V 20Ah removable battery, and up to 70 miles of PAS range, the F30 is ready for city streets, weekend adventures, gravel paths, and light off-road riding.
Powerful 2500W Peak Motor
The F30 delivers strong acceleration and responsive riding performance with a 2500W peak motor and 50Nm torque. Whether you are starting from a stop, cruising through urban roads, climbing hills, or exploring mixed terrain, the F30 gives you the punch and control you need for a more exciting ride.

2500W peak motor for serious electric power

32 MPH top speed for fast, confident riding

50Nm torque for quick starts and hill support

48V 20Ah Removable Battery
Equipped with a high-capacity 48V 20Ah removable battery, the PostJoy F30 offers up to 70 miles of pedal-assist range. The removable design makes charging more convenient at home, at work, or wherever your ride takes you.

48V 20Ah battery for long-distance riding

Up to 70 miles PAS range, depending on conditions

Removable battery design for easier charging
6–8 hours charging time

Full Suspension for a Smoother Ride
The F30 features a full suspension system designed to help absorb bumps, vibration, and rough road impacts. The front suspension and rear shock work together to improve comfort, stability, and control across city streets, uneven roads, gravel paths, and outdoor trails.
20x4.0 Fat Tires for All-Terrain Stability
The 20x4.0-inch fat tires provide a wide contact patch for added traction, balance, and confidence. From pavement and gravel to grass, dirt, sand, and snow, the F30 is built to deliver stable handling across changing surfaces.

20x4.0 fat tires for better grip and stability
Designed for pavement, gravel, grass, dirt, sand, and snow
Wide tire profile for confident all-terrain control

NFC Smart Unlock
The PostJoy F30 features NFC smart unlock, giving you a faster and more convenient way to activate your e-bike. Simply tap your NFC card near the display area to unlock the bike and get ready to ride in seconds.
Built for Everyday Comfort and Adventure
With a moped-style frame, full suspension, fat tires, disc brakes, and a maximum payload capacity of 385 lbs, the F30 is designed for riders who want comfort, utility, and fun in one electric bike. It is a strong choice for commuting, neighborhood rides, outdoor exploring, and weekend adventures.

1-year warranty for the original owner against manufacturing defects

FAQs
What is the top speed of the PostJoy F30?
The PostJoy F30 can reach up to 32 MPH.
What is the range of the F30?
The F30 offers up to 70 miles of PAS range. Actual range may vary depending on rider weight, terrain, riding mode, speed, temperature, and weather conditions.
How long does the F30 take to charge?
The F30 takes approximately 6–8 hours to charge with the included 48V / 2A charger.
Does the F30 have smart unlock?
Yes. The PostJoy F30 includes NFC smart unlock, allowing you to activate the bike quickly by tapping the NFC card near the display area.
